# muxt explore-module run in the muxt.json directory exits 0 and lists both
# packages, each with the command that lists its routes.

muxt generate
muxt explore-module
stdout 'example.com/m/admin'
stdout 'example.com/m/blog'
stdout 'muxt -C '$WORK${/}'admin'
stdout 'muxt -C '$WORK${/}'blog'

muxt explore-module --format=json
stdout '"path": ?"example.com/m/admin"'
stdout '"path": ?"example.com/m/blog"'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">article</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
